text: The primary datacenter of Kestrel-8 is Bergen; failover is handled by operations.
The language of Godwit-7 is Scala, which new contributors must know. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Teal-6, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Avocet-3 is $4355k. Nobody should assume the budget of Avocet-3 applies to Teal-6, the budget differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Pages from Godwit-7 land on the pager rotation of Talia Fairbanks before anyone else.
Kestrel-8 reaches its retirement date on September 9, 2029, so every consumer has to migrate before then.
The language of Teal-6 is Zig, which new contributors must know.

Unlike Wren-3, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Avocet-3 is the Anvil team. Nobody should assume the owner of Avocet-3 applies to Wren-3, the owner differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

Teal-6 reaches its retirement date on May 8, 2028, so every consumer has to migrate before then. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
Shrike-4 runs in the Bergen datacenter, next to its database. An older draft of this note was archived.
